howto.what: Claude 会生成一篇超过 600 字的杂志风格长文，包含刊头、大标题、副标题、作者署名、正文（含图片、引用块）、作者简介卡片和推荐文章卡片。
howto.when: 当你要求写一篇长文章、博客、案例研究或杂志风格内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于远程办公的博客长文。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate a magazine-style long article (600+ words) with masthead, hero section (title, subtitle, author, reading time), body text with figures and pull quotes, author bio card, and related posts cards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a long article, blog post, case study, or magazine-style content.

say_en.text: Write a long blog post about remote work.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a fully formatted long article.

say_en.text: Create a case study with quotes and author bio.
